name: dsh-windows-readiness-proof
description: Verify pinned, sanitized Windows enterprise observations for DSH readiness without changing the host.

interface.longDescription: Evaluate a SHA-256-pinned, sanitized Windows host observation against explicit DSH runtime, policy, filesystem, service, connectivity and storage requirements without executing collectors or changing the host.
defaultPrompt: Verify this managed Windows DSH readiness manifest and show control gaps.
